mapper.select: SELECT id, name, item_type, item_id, url FROM graph_info WHERE item_type = 2 AND item_id = #{room_id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT li.id, li.type, li.name FROM label_info li LEFT JOIN room_label rl ON li.id = rl.label_id WHERE rl.room_id = #{room_id} AND li.is_deleted = 0 AND rl.is_deleted = 0
SELECT id, user_id, room_id, collect_status, create_time, update_time FROM room_collect WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND room_id = #{roomId} AND is_deleted = 0
